0022600125.text: The Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) host the Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) in a regular season game. Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (ankle), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both out. The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 121-114 win in Atlanta on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-0.
